enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +15: Passive: +15 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Lightning Strike: This weapon stores the power of a volatile thunderstorm deep within. Occasionally, this dynamic power comes to the surface, devastating enemies with a massive lightning strike.
Shocking Blast 3: This weapon arcs with deadly electricity, dealing 3d6 Electric damage on a successful hit, and an additional 3d6 Electric damage on a critical hit.
Screeching 7: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to pulse with sound, dealing 7d6 Sonic damage on each critical hit.
Thunderstorm Lore +12: Passive: Your Sonic and Lightning spells gain a 12% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Power of the Thunderstorm +84: Passive: +84 Equipment bonus to Sonic and Electric Spell Power.
